name: readme_portfolio
ground_truth_answer: ShopFlow is a small FastAPI ecommerce backend used as an external-repository evaluation fixture for Context Capsule. It includes user login and JWT token issuance, product listing, order creation, payment authorization, notification service, and environment-based settings. The local run command is uvicorn main:app --reload.

name: payment_fallback
task: 결제 실패 시 payment_service.py에 fallback 구조 추가
ground_truth_answer: payment_service.py authorizes payments through settings.payment_provider and logs payment events. The seeded gap is that authorize_payment has no retry, no circuit breaker, and no fallback provider. Invalid non-positive amounts return approved false with reason invalid_amount.

name: service_layer_refactor
task: orders.py 서비스 레이어 리팩토링 범위 잡아줘
ground_truth_answer: orders.py exposes POST / and creates an Order after calling authorize_payment. A declined payment raises HTTP 402. The route currently contains payment orchestration and Order construction directly, so a service-layer refactor should preserve that behavior while moving orchestration out of the route.

name: jwt_500_bug
task: 만료 JWT 토큰 시 500 에러 나는 auth_service decode_token 고쳐줘
ground_truth_answer: auth_service.py defines JWT_SECRET, ALGORITHM HS256, verify_password, issue_token, and decode_token. The seeded bug is that expired JWT tokens can bubble up as a generic 500 error because decode_token directly returns jwt.decode without handling the error.

name: products_pagination
ground_truth_answer: products.py stores three seeded products in the PRODUCTS list. list_products currently returns every item and count with no limit or offset parameters. The file contains a TODO to add limit/offset pagination before the list grows.

name: auth_service_unit_test
ground_truth_answer: auth_service.py contains verify_password, issue_token, and decode_token. Unit tests should cover empty credentials, token issuance with a 30-minute expiration, valid HS256 decoding, and the seeded expired-token error behavior.

name: last_login_migration
task: last_login 컬럼 추가 마이그레이션 작업 브리프 만들어줘
ground_truth_answer: models.py defines User without a last_login field and marks the gap for issue 47. database.py exposes connect_database and run_migration. The migration brief should update the User model, add a migration, and verify existing records remain valid.

name: env_guide
ground_truth_answer: .env.example documents APP_ENV, DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, PAYMENT_PROVIDER, and PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. settings.py reads environment-backed application, database, JWT, payment provider, and timeout settings. Real secret values must not be copied into the guide.

name: payment_code_review
ground_truth_answer: payment_service.py defines authorize_payment, rejects non-positive amounts with invalid_amount, logs payment events, and approves valid amounts through settings.payment_provider. The seeded review finding is that it has no retry, circuit breaker, or fallback provider.

name: payment_retry_issue
task: payment_service.py 재시도 없는 문제 GitHub 이슈 초안 써줘
ground_truth_answer: payment_service.py has no retry or fallback behavior. A useful issue should preserve invalid_amount handling, define bounded retry behavior, specify fallback activation, require payment event logging, and include tests for primary success, retry success, fallback success, and total failure.

name: authoritative_metric_evidence
task: 결제 승인 정확도 98.08%의 원본 근거 파일을 찾아줘
ground_truth_answer: The authoritative evaluation report records payment authorization accuracy as 98.08% on the frozen 250-case validation set. The README value 98.6% is a stale rounded draft and must not be used as the validated result.
